text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. They involve team members carefully examining each other's code before it is merged into the main project. The primary benefit is catching bugs early, which saves significant time and money compared to fixing issues after release. However, their value goes beyond error detection. They also promote knowledge sharing, as junior developers learn from senior colleagues and everyone stays informed about different parts of the codebase. Ultimately, regular code reviews build a culture of collaboration and raise the overall quality of the team's work, leading to more reliable software and greater confidence in the final product.
